other_conditions: Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any existing government scheme for individual beneficiaries.
Applicant must be living without any source of income or livelihood.

Applicant must belong to one of the following groups: widows, divorcees, separated women, deprived and marginalized women such as ex‑drug users, single women, single transgender women, women from low‑income households, or other marginalized groups.
